title: Weather & Hydrology Stations | H600 / H700 | Hitelecom
metaDescription: Explore Hitelecom H600 weather and H700 hydrology stations. Configure 2–12 sensor channels, solar or grid power, and the required communication version for the site.

categoryDescriptions.257: Specify the measurements, power and data path for the site. H600 supports local weather observations; H700 is configured for hydrological monitoring.
categoryDescriptions.275: Configure H600 for the weather parameters, power system and communication version required by the installation.
categoryDescriptions.274: Configure H700 around the selected water and environmental measurements, sensor installation and onward data connection.

catalogIntro: Start with the measurements needed at each site, then confirm the sensor set, installation, power and communication configuration.
sharedConfigNote: Each station is configured with 2–12 sensor channels. IP65 is the published station protection reference; sensing assemblies, power and communication are selected per project.
